Hi Samantha —

Thanks for signing up for Redwood! I’m Marissa on the SDR team — congrats on getting started. If you’d like a quick walkthrough of the platform and a chance to ask questions about Dedicated/Private deployments, please pick a 30-minute slot that works for you: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/30min

Quick notes:
- If you’re evaluating cost/latency for a specific workload, reply with a sample prompt or token/sec estimate and we’ll tailor the demo.
- If you prefer, we can loop in one of our infra specialists for deeper architecture questions.

Attachment: redwood_onepager.pdf (1 page — product summary)

Best,
Marissa Cole
SDR, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
